name: Savings USDD
oneLiner: sUSDD is the TRON DAO Reserve's savings wrapper of USDD; share price accrues savings yield while final par exit inherits USDD's PSM and reserve mechanics.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-verified 2026-08-08 at Ethereum block 25712115 and BNB Chain block 114787010. The official inventory identifies Ethereum 0xc5d6a7b61d18afa11435a889557b068bb9f29930 and BNB Chain 0x8ba9da757d1d66c58b1ae7e2ed6c04087348a82d as sUSDD; both remained identical-size direct deployments with zero EIP-1967 implementation slots. Their verified SavingsUsdd source exposes ordinary ERC-20 transfers and allowance-gated ERC-4626 withdrawals, with no owner, role administration, pause, blacklist, denylist, seizure, or arbitrary-holder burn. The valid inherited finding is from tracked parent usdd-tron-dao-reserve; PSM, reserve, redemption, and collateral impairment do not create a direct wrapper holder-freeze power.

collateral: USDD deposited into the USDD savings system; sUSDD remains economically backed by USDD while savings yield accrues through the wrapper exchange rate
pegMechanism: Users deposit USDD to receive sUSDD, whose value appreciates versus USDD as savings yield accrues; final par exit inherits USDD's PSM and reserve mechanics

oracleRisk.summary: sUSDD is an ERC-4626 savings wrapper over USDD and has no borrower-owned collateral positions or local liquidation engine. Its required USDD parent carries the separately reviewed governed CDP oracle, auction, deficit, and shutdown branch.

branchApplicability.rationale: USDD documents sUSDD as an ERC-4626 tokenized vault minted when users deposit USDD and redeemable back to USDD through its exchange rate. The savings wrapper does not originate borrower debt or operate collateral-ratio-triggered liquidations. The variantOf relationship preserves the complete USDD parent branch review.

mintAuthority.summary: sUSDD is an immutable DSR-style savings wrapper (SavingsUsdd, forked from DAI Foundation) over USDD. The contract has no owner, no admin, no proxy — all parameters are immutable (pot, usddJoin set at constructor). Shares are minted/burned only by deposit/withdrawal of USDD. Base USDD mint authority is inherited from reviewed usdd-tron-dao-reserve.

review.evidence: Wrapper surface verified at Ethereum block 25295198 and BSC block 103632491: SavingsUsdd is an immutable DAI-Foundation-fork DSR contract with no owner, no proxy, no upgrade path. asset() confirmed USDD 0x4f8e5de... on both chains. Base USDD mint authority tracked under usdd-tron-dao-reserve. Reconciliation review (2026-08-08): USDD 2.0 is a MakerDAO-style on-chain CDP system (Vat, Dog, Clip, Spot, Jug, OSM, PSM, collateral auctions) whose documentation states all collateral backing USDD is held in publicly verifiable smart contracts, and sUSDD is an immutable ERC-4626 wrapper fully redeemable for USDD. The mint path creates no off-chain reserve claim, so reconciliation is not-applicable. No prudential regulator and no third-party reserve attestation exist; the documentation's audits section covers smart-contract code only.

reserveReview.rationale: sUSDD is a savings-wrapper share over USDD rather than a separate collateral portfolio. The exact direct reserve is the wrapper position; USDD reserve, market, governance, and redemption risks remain inherited through the tracked parent dependency.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Exact live single-asset row and USDD's sUSDD mechanism documentation
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No additional direct sUSDD reserve slice is identified; underlying USDD reserve composition is tracked on the parent asset.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: sUSDD is the immutable SavingsUsdd wrapper deployed natively on Ethereum and BNB Chain over natively-issued USDD on each chain (per-chain bytecode diff 2026-07-20; USDD's BNB Chain deployment is native per the official deployment registry). No bridge route carries the claim.

routes.reviewNote: Canonical home deployment: sUSDD on Ethereum is the immutable SavingsUsdd wrapper (no proxy, no owner(); bytecode read 2026-07-20) minting sUSDD against USDD deposits.

Native deployment: the BSC sUSDD is the same immutable SavingsUsdd ERC-4626 wrapper (11,085-byte contract, name 'Savings Usdd'; bytecode differs from the Ethereum wrapper only in the embedded per-chain protocol addresses, diffed 2026-07-20) wrapping natively-issued BNB Chain USDD 0x45E51bc23D592EB2DBA86da3985299f7895d66Ba — USDD announced native deployment on BNB Chain (Oct 2025) with the full CDP stack, so no bridge mints this deployment.
